description: Northern Ireland Road Safety Partnership 2011-2019 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. The Northern Ireland Road Safety Partnership (RSP) aims to support the government’s Road Safety Strategy by reducing speeding and injury collisions through targeted enforcement and educational initiatives. The Partnership Board oversees the work of the RSP and includes representatives from the PSNI, Department for Infrastructure, Department of Justice, Policing Board and Courts Service.
